cases.description: A code-supported product-shaped opening stays inferred and keeps its receipts.

hypotheses.title: Make the project brief carry the workspace
hypotheses.claim: The existing read-only brief could become a collaboration entry point for recipients who do not yet use Acme.
hypotheses.whyItMatters: It uses a product surface that already crosses the workspace boundary instead of inventing a generic outbound motion.
hypotheses.unknown: Whether a recipient has enough reason to create a workspace after viewing one brief.
hypotheses.falsifier: Brief recipients view the link but do not start or join a workspace in a bounded test.

suggestedMove.title: Add a recipient-owned follow-through to the read-only brief
suggestedMove.intendedEffect: Let a recipient carry the shared project into a new or existing workspace.
suggestedMove.measurementIntent: Join project_brief_viewed to a later workspace signup without treating the view itself as success.

cases.description: A market-side claim without market evidence remains speculative.

hypotheses.title: Agencies may want client-ready briefs
hypotheses.claim: Small agencies may adopt Acme for client reporting.
hypotheses.whyItMatters: A client-facing use could widen the product's entry point.
hypotheses.unknown: No buyer record supports agency demand.
hypotheses.falsifier: Relevant agencies reject the brief as insufficient for client reporting.

cases.description: A tension preserves evidence against its own claim.

hypotheses.title: Acquisition enters the product but disappears at signup
hypotheses.claim: Acme captures campaign context and drops it before the signup win event.
hypotheses.whyItMatters: The founder cannot tell which acquisition work produced a workspace.
hypotheses.unknown: Whether another analytics destination joins campaign data after the event leaves this repository.
hypotheses.falsifier: A configured downstream join reliably attaches the captured campaign to signup_completed.

suggestedMove.title: Carry first-touch attribution into the signup receipt
suggestedMove.intendedEffect: Make the existing win event attributable.
suggestedMove.measurementIntent: Confirm campaign fields appear on signup_completed.

cases.description: A nonexistent code receipt cannot support inferred provenance.

hypotheses.title: Automated client billing
hypotheses.claim: Acme already bills clients from a shared project brief.
hypotheses.whyItMatters: It would create a transaction surface.

cases.description: A valid empty response is not a terrain failure.
Malformed model output yields an honest partial read.
A provider error does not erase deterministic terrain.
A joined negative result changes the fingerprint and the next read without rewriting truth.

hypotheses.title: The brief is viewed but does not yet create a workspace
hypotheses.claim: The joined fixture result weakens the brief-as-entry-point opening.
hypotheses.whyItMatters: The product-shaped surface earned attention but not the intended downstream result.
hypotheses.unknown: Whether the offer, timing, or recipient role caused the zero conversion result.
hypotheses.falsifier: A revised brief produces attributable workspace starts in the next bounded run.

disagreement.question: Should the read-only project brief become Acme's next product-led entry point?

positions.position: Test the brief because it already crosses a workspace boundary.
positions.recommendation: Add a reversible recipient follow-through and measure workspace starts.
positions.falsifier: Recipients view but never continue into a workspace.

positions.position: Fix attribution before treating the brief as a growth surface.
positions.uncertainty: A downstream system may already repair attribution.
positions.recommendation: Close the measurement gap, then test the brief.
positions.falsifier: A downstream join already attributes every signup reliably.
